title: 最大合金数
summary: 有 k 台机器，每台制造一份合金需要固定数量的 n 种金属；已有库存且可按单价补购，在预算内求使用同一台机器最多能制造多少份合金。
insight: 固定制造数量后，每台机器所需补购成本都可直接计算，数量越大可行性单调不增，因此二分答案。对任一金属，即使把全部预算只用于购买它，制造量也不能超过 (stock+budget/cost)/composition；各机器取最紧限制，再取最大值即可得到安全二分上界。
pitfalls: 一批合金只能选择同一台机器制造
库存足够的金属不产生负成本
数量、需求量和花费都要用 long
可行性是存在至少一台机器不超预算

solutions.title: 二分制造数量
solutions.idea: 以任一机器能否在预算内制造给定数量作为单调判定。
steps: 按每台机器的各金属独立预算上界求全局 upper
对 middle 逐台计算补购费用
某台机器费用不超过 budget 即判定可行
可行时提升 low，否则降低 high

code.java: class Solution { private boolean feasible(long amount,int budget,List<List<Integer>> composition,List<Integer> stock,List<Integer> cost){for(List<Integer> recipe:composition){long spent=0;for(int metal=0;metal<stock.size();metal++){long shortage=amount*recipe.get(metal)-stock.get(metal);if(shortage>0){spent+=shortage*cost.get(metal);if(spent>budget)break;}}if(spent<=budget)return true;}return false;}public int maxNumberOfAlloys(int n,int k,int budget,List<List<Integer>> composition,List<Integer> stock,List<Integer> cost){long upper=0;for(List<Integer> recipe:composition){long machineUpper=Long.MAX_VALUE;for(int metal=0;metal<n;metal++){long individuallyAffordable=stock.get(metal)+(long)budget/cost.get(metal);machineUpper=Math.min(machineUpper,individuallyAffordable/recipe.get(metal));}upper=Math.max(upper,machineUpper);}long low=0,high=upper+1;while(low+1<high){long middle=(low+high)/2;if(feasible(middle,budget,composition,stock,cost))low=middle;else high=middle;}return (int)low;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { private fun feasible(amount:Long,budget:Int,composition:List<List<Int>>,stock:List<Int>,cost:List<Int>):Boolean{for(recipe in composition){var spent=0L;for(metal in stock.indices){val shortage=amount*recipe[metal]-stock[metal];if(shortage>0){spent+=shortage*cost[metal];if(spent>budget)break}};if(spent<=budget)return true};return false}fun maxNumberOfAlloys(n:Int,k:Int,budget:Int,composition:List<List<Int>>,stock:List<Int>,cost:List<Int>):Int{var upper=0L;for(recipe in composition){var machineUpper=Long.MAX_VALUE;for(metal in 0 until n){val individuallyAffordable=stock[metal].toLong()+budget/cost[metal];machineUpper=minOf(machineUpper,individuallyAffordable/recipe[metal])};upper=maxOf(upper,machineUpper)};var low=0L;var high=upper+1;while(low+1<high){val middle=(low+high)/2;if(feasible(middle,budget,composition,stock,cost))low=middle else high=middle};return low.toInt()} }
code.cpp: class Solution { bool feasible(long long amount,int budget,vector<vector<int>>& composition,vector<int>& stock,vector<int>& cost){for(auto& recipe:composition){long long spent=0;for(int metal=0;metal<(int)stock.size();++metal){long long shortage=amount*recipe[metal]-stock[metal];if(shortage>0){spent+=shortage*cost[metal];if(spent>budget)break;}}if(spent<=budget)return true;}return false;}public:int maxNumberOfAlloys(int n,int k,int budget,vector<vector<int>>& composition,vector<int>& stock,vector<int>& cost){long long upper=0;for(auto& recipe:composition){long long machineUpper=LLONG_MAX;for(int metal=0;metal<n;++metal){long long individuallyAffordable=stock[metal]+1LL*budget/cost[metal];machineUpper=min(machineUpper,individuallyAffordable/recipe[metal]);}upper=max(upper,machineUpper);}long long low=0,high=upper+1;while(low+1<high){long long middle=(low+high)/2;if(feasible(middle,budget,composition,stock,cost))low=middle;else high=middle;}return low;} };
